The overdue documents do not carry the blocked side's sentence. condition / resolved_by / effect have no home in any document.

- No other problem's tool named in any document (each tool name appears only in its own hub); no route, checklist, aggregated chain, wrong-vs-right contrast or cross-problem FAQ.
- Titles general ("Overdue Hosting Renewals at Checkout — Web Hosting Plans"; "Web Hosting Plans: Upgrading Harborline Cloud 4 to Harborline Cloud 8" names the on_request policy's subject).
- Computation documents name no factor, no exception list, no pointer; the assembly sentences mention credits/fees only as the source result sentences do. Factor documents name no other document, no customer tier, no evidence row.
- Factor findability from record words: account tier name -> reseller schedule; bundled_hosting_id / renewal lines -> bundled-domain credit; email subscription seats on primary domain -> mail credit; certificate product + hosting_id -> certificate credit; declined auto-renew attempts -> late fee; resource notices -> outgrown credit; upgrade proration lines -> welcome credit; billing term -> billed share. All reachable without the computation document.
